name: Are roofing project scope consultations free?

mainEntity.name: Are roofing project scope consultations free?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost structure for roofing project scope consultations can vary by company. Discounted Roofing Co. typically offers initial consultations at no charge to provide a baseline assessment and discuss potential solutions. It's important to clarify if there are any fees associated with detailed reports or engineering assessments if they are required beyond the standard consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial roofing project scope consultations are typically free at Discounted Roofing Co., but check for fees on detailed reports.
